answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% committed volume, a primary-vendor switch or deferral creates unacceptable near-term delivery exposure. Negotiate an incumbent renewal anchored to market benchmarking, targeting the mandated 18% spend reduction through unit price, volume tiers, and payment terms while preserving service and delivery commitments. Verify the prior negotiation record before committing because the achievable savings magnitude is uncertain.
